title: Engineering State Machine Forensic Qualification Report

testCaseSummary.name: Test 1: State Definition
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified all state domains contain correct typed states.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 2: Valid Transition
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified basic allowed state transition was successfully executed.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 3: Illegal Transition
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified illegal transitions are strictly rejected by the domain layer.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 4: Guard Enforcement
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified guard enforcement under PASS, FAIL, and UNPROVEN inputs.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 5: Event Generation
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified transitions trigger appropriate, frozen unified events.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 6: Event/State Consistency
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified state and event remain fully consistent.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 7: State History
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified monotonic append-only state transition history log.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 8: Reconstruction
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified state reconstruction from event log perfectly matches current memory state.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 9: Persistence
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified correct persistence and cross-session restoration.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 10: Dependency Invalidation
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified cascading invalidations on genuine downstream dependencies.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 11: Revision Awareness
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified creating a new upstream revision invalidates dependents.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 12: Concurrent Transition
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified optimistic locking prevents concurrent stale transitions.

testCaseSummary.name: Test 13: UI Bypass
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified that UI and external services cannot mutate frozen state directly.

testCaseSummary.name: Scenario 1: Illegal transition
testCaseSummary.detail: Attempt to transition ACTIVE -> DRAFT was successfully rejected.

testCaseSummary.name: Scenario 4: Forged actor
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified state machine rejects transition without a valid, typed actor.

testCaseSummary.name: Scenario 20: Transition from ARCHIVED
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified transition from ARCHIVED requires explicit reactivation override.

testCaseSummary.name: Scenario 16: GUARD = UNPROVEN
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified transition is blocked if any guard evaluates to UNPROVEN.

testCaseSummary.name: Scenario 17: Corrupted persisted state
testCaseSummary.detail: Verified STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_FAILURE raised on mismatched persisted status.
